title: [ONNX] Exporter crashes when fx node output includes None
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

For example,

```python
# image_tokens_masks could be None
if not return_dict:
    return (output, image_tokens_masks)
```

https://github.com/HiDream-ai/HiDream-I1/blob/5f92bab45f1dfb1e794ee357286a5b837eaf4400/hi_diffusers/models/transformers/transformer_hidream_image.py#L524

However, during the translation from exported program to onnx graph, exporter does not consider None as one of the potential node outputs: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/03b254e49f2d4c092e6ca712e5702cf2895aa47e/torch/onnx/_internal/exporter/_core.py#L714-L737


### Versions

main
